mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.name AS user_name FROM approvals a JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id WHERE a.budget_request_id = #{budgetRequestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approvals (budget_request_id, user_id, approval_status, approval_step, comment) VALUES (#{budgetRequestId}, #{userId}, #{approvalStatus}, #{approvalStep}, #{comment})
